title: All the Pieces Matter! A Six-stage Analysis of an Underground Fraud Ecosystem on Dread
abstract: arXiv:2611.18630v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cyber-enabled fraud is a dominant global threat that causes severe financial loss, identity theft, and widespread psychological harm. This illicit economy relies on a highly specialized underground ecosystem where distinct actors exchange technical tools, operational techniques, and laundering channels. This research presents a case study of one such live fraud ecosystem from the perspective of a cohesive six-stage value chain spanning from preparation to monetization: Capability, Data Acquisition, Technique Sharing, Identity Forgery, Execution, and Extraction. Analyzing 67,976 posts and 305,048 comments from nine communities on the Tor-based darknet forum Dread, we map user trajectories, content distribution, and the adoption of generative AI. translated_abstract: 网络诈骗是一种主要的全球性威胁，会造成严重的经济损失、身份盗窃和广泛的心理伤害。这种非法经济依赖于一个高度专业化的地下生态系统，其中不同的参与者在此交换技术工具、操作技巧和洗钱渠道。本研究从一条从准备到变现的连贯六阶段价值链的视角，对一个活跃的欺诈生态系统进行了案例研究，这六个阶段为：能力储备、数据获取、技术分享、身份伪造、执行与变现提取。通过分析基于Tor的暗网论坛Dread上九个社区的67,976条帖子和305,048条评论，我们绘制了用户轨迹、内容分布以及生成式AI的采用情况。我们的研究结果表明，该生态系统的结构凝聚力由一小部分产生绝大多数内容的“桥梁者”（bridgers）所维系。在与保持度分布的零模型对比中，三……
tldr: 该研究通过分析暗网论坛Dread上九个社区的6.7万余条帖子和30万余条评论，提出了从能力储备到变现的六阶段欺诈价值链分析框架，并揭示了少数“桥梁者”用户是维系整个地下欺诈生态系统结构凝聚力的关键。
en_tdlr: By analyzing over 67,000 posts and 305,000 comments from nine communities on the darknet forum Dread, this study proposes a six-stage fraud value chain framework spanning from capability preparation to monetization, revealing that a thin layer of "bridgers" sustains the structural cohesion of the entire underground fraud ecosystem.
